fullPassage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have contributed to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us bond with others. From an evolutionary perspective, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities (including attention, perception, memory, movement, expressions, etc.). For example, fear makes us very attentive, narrows our perceptual focus to threatening stimuli, will cause us either to face a situation (fight) or avoid it (flight), and may cause us to remember an experience more acutely (so that we avoid the threat in the future). Regardless of the specific ways in which they activate our systems, the specific emotions we possess are thought to exist because they have helped us (as a species) survive challenges within our environment long ago. If they had not helped us adapt and survive, they would not have evolved with us.

❌ ② movement(움직임): 신체의 동작이지 인식 능력이 아님

✅ ③ perception: 감각을 통해 무언가를 인식하는 능력으로 영영 정의와 일치 ←정답

❌ ④ survival(생존): 살아남는 것이지 감각 인식이 아님
det.tip: perception = 지각. aware through the senses가 핵심

questions.passage: Fear has helped us avoid dangers, and __________ (express) anger helps us scare off threats. From an evolutionary perspective, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities (including attention, perception, memory, movement, expressions, etc.)
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 빈칸은 뒤의 동사 helps의 주어 자리이다. 'anger를 표현하는 것'이라는 명사 역할이 필요하므로 동명사 expressing이 적절. 동명사 주어는 단수 취급하여 helps와 수 일치. express → expressing
det.tip: 동명사 주어(expressing ...) + 단수 동사(helps)

questions.passage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have __________ (contribute) to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us bond with others.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.analysis: 'they have __________ to our survival'에서 조동사 have 뒤에 현재완료를 완성하는 과거분사가 필요. '기여해 왔다'는 현재완료 의미. contribute → contributed
det.tip: have + contributed = 현재완료 (기여해 왔다)

questions.passage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have contributed to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us bond with others. From an __________, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities (including attention, perception, memory, movement, expressions, etc.). For example, fear makes us very attentive, narrows our perceptual focus to threatening stimuli, will cause us either to face a situation (fight) or avoid it (flight), and may cause us to remember an experience more acutely (so that we avoid the threat in the future). Regardless of the specific ways in which they activate our systems, the specific emotions we possess are thought to exist because they have helped us (as a species) survive challenges within our environment long ago. If they had not helped us adapt and survive, they would not have evolved with us.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① a historical record(역사적 기록): 감정의 기능을 생존·진화로 설명하는 맥락과 다름

✅ ② an evolutionary perspective: 'From __________, an emotion is a kind of program ... directs many of our activities'에서 감정을 생존에 기여한 일종의 프로그램으로 보는 '진화적 관점(evolutionary perspective)'이 적절 ← 정답

❌ ③ a personal opinion(개인적 의견): 과학적 설명 맥락과 부적절

❌ ④ a random guess(무작위 추측): 체계적 설명과 반대
det.tip: From an evolutionary perspective = 진화적 관점에서

questions.passage: Our emotions are thought to exist because they have contributed to our survival as a species. Fear has helped us avoid dangers, expressing anger helps us scare off threats, and expressing positive emotions helps us bond with others. From an evolutionary perspective, an emotion is a kind of "program" that, when triggered, directs many of our activities (including attention, perception, memory, movement, expressions, etc.). For example, fear makes us very attentive, narrows our perceptual focus to threatening stimuli, will cause us either to face a situation (fight) or avoid it (flight), and may cause us to remember an experience more acutely (so that we avoid the threat in __________). Regardless of the specific ways in which they activate our systems, the specific emotions we possess are thought to exist because they have helped us (as a species) survive challenges within our environment long ago. If they had not helped us adapt and survive, they would not have evolved with us.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
❌ ① the past(과거): 위협을 피하는 것은 앞으로의 일이므로 부적절

❌ ② the crowd(군중): 문맥과 무관

❌ ③ the dark(어둠): 문맥과 무관

✅ ④ the future: 'may cause us to remember an experience more acutely (so that we avoid the threat in __________)'에서 경험을 강렬히 기억해 앞으로 '미래(the future)'에 위협을 피한다는 맥락 ← 정답
det.tip: avoid the threat in the future = 미래에 위협을 피하다
